mentions.name: Alternative Bluesky client
mentions.description: An alternative client for Bluesky built as a clean-sheet implementation that improves on the default client's messy, legacy UX decisions. The author also frames a larger vision: using ATProto as a basis for software that organizes workflows incorporating agents, based on the theory that enterprise group productivity software is really a species of social media.
mentions.problem: The default Bluesky client is a bit messy and embodies legacy UX decisions that a clean-sheet implementation could improve upon.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making alternative client software for Bluesky. In part because I think the default client is a bit messy and embodies a few legacy UX decisions that clean sheet implementation could improve upon.
